messages.body_plain:
Hi Ellen,

Just put together my notes from 4-5 years ago that would help you get going 
if it's still something you need.

https://medium.com/datatime/rpostgresql-on-os-x-mavericks-yosemite-and-beyond-3dedc0558eb0

Begli


On Thursday, October 6, 2016 at 6:35:46 AM UTC-4, Ellen wrote:
>
> Hi Maria, 
>
> Did you solve this? I have exactly the same problem - my code with 
> dbConnect worked until recently. I tried to install RPostgreSQL from github 
> and get the same error as you. It would be great to know how you fixed it!
>
> Best wishes
>
> Ellen
>
>
>
> On Monday, 11 July 2016 18:26:58 UTC+1, mst...-8Z8B9NtlZsFWk0Htik3J/w at public.gmane.org wrote:
>>
>> Hi Ian,
>>
>> Thanks for the quick reply. I wasn't able to install the latest though. 
>> See the attached screenshot of what happened.
>>

>> <https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/-bka5Duw9uDc/V4PW0-iMsaI/AAAAAAAAAZg/gstt9qRyKVQg5OxgAxN8eAK1tDBuFJeUwCLcB/s1600/Screen%2BShot%2B2016-07-11%2Bat%2B10.23.40%2BAM.png>
>>
>>
>>
>> Thanks,
>> Maria

>>>
>>> library(RPostgreSQL)
>>> drv <- dbDriver("PostgreSQL")
>>> con <- dbConnect(drv,
>>> host='<host>',

>>>

>>>
